role: parent preparation of finite retained historical/current context identities

other_controls: Every historical source descriptor resolves to the exact known current descriptor or an explicit retirement.
Unknown digest, incorrect length and accessor metadata are rejected; accessors are not invoked.
Public metadata mutations do not alter the private identity map or physical guard.
Independent copied checkout rejects extra, missing and reintroduced retired product members.
Final callback changing an earlier physical member is rejected by a complete callback-free closing sweep.

limits: Identity preparation only; not integrated into the retained source epoch or build-scope predicates.
Prior build/Bazel source judgments still require revalidation against the current context before admission.
No library source, golden, ledger disposition, peer installation, remote branch or Actions run changed.
